market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with elevated volatility. Oil shock and AUD weakness create sector rotation from financials to materials/energy. RBA hike expectations and IMF fiscal warning cap upside. Bathla insolvency and private credit concerns may trigger selective credit downgrades. Expect 1-2% index volatility over coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining exploration, AI infrastructure buildout, and energy transition support 6-12 month upside. However, immigration tightening, fiscal austerity, and Trump trade policy create persistent headwinds. ASX 200 likely to grind higher in materials and tech but face pressure in consumer and REITs. RBA policy normalisation is the key swing factor.
